title: Design: the pinned customer row matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure customer A and customer B are next to each other in name order, and each has more overdue invoices than fit on the screen.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group expanded.
  • Open the design picture "The customer row stays pinned" (ar-ap-p3-the-customer-row-stays-pinned.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Scroll down slowly into customer A's rows.
  2. Keep scrolling until customer B's group row reaches the top.
  3. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's group row stays just under the column headings while its rows slide beneath it.
  • As in the picture, the pinned row shows the blue chevron, the bold name and count and the grey Phone and Credit term, over the rows sliding beneath it.

Step 2:

  • Customer B's row pushes customer A's up and off and takes its place.
  • Only one group row is pinned at a time.

Step 3:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html).
